title: PandaScore REST API for All Videogames

operations.description:
Get the latest additions.

This endpoint only shows unchanged objects.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] additions [PATH] additions [PARAMS] page per since type videogame [SCHEMA] addition deletion incident incidents league match non of player serie team tournament type

operations.description:

operations.description:
